programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Encounter
programmes.d: A World War II veteran and a Japanese-American gardener battle each other over a war that ended more than 20 years ago.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Mr. Garrity and the Graves
programmes.d: Jared Garrity arrives in the Old West town of Happiness, Arizona, proclaiming he can revive the dead.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Brain Center at Whipple's
programmes.d: A factory CEO replaces human workers with machines.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Come Wander with Me
programmes.d: A singer's song becomes tragically real.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Lonely
programmes.d: Corry is stranded on an asteroid after being convicted of a crime. He receives as a present a robot who looks, sounds, and acts like a real woman.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Time Enough at Last
programmes.d: A bank teller, Henry Bemis, longs for time alone to read books. He gets his wish...

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Perchance to Dream
programmes.d: A man is terrified of falling asleep for fear he might die.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Judgment Night
programmes.d: In 1942, a German wonders why he's on the deck of a British steamship, with no memory of how he got there, and an overwhelming sense of impending doom.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: And When the Sky Was Opened
programmes.d: Three astronauts have returned from this first space flight. Major Gart is hospitalized with a broken leg. The other two, Colonels Harrington and Forbes head for a bar. Harrington gets a strange feeling…

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: What You Need
programmes.d: A two-bit thug thinks he's found the key to a better life in an old sidewalk salesman who has the uncanny ability to tell people what they need the most.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Four of Us are Dying
programmes.d: A man who can change his face to resemble others gets into hot water with gangsters.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Third From the Sun
programmes.d: With all-out nuclear war about to ignite, a scientist and his pilot friend plot to escape on an experimental spaceship.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: I Shot an Arrow into the Air
programmes.d: Three astronauts crash on what they believe to be an asteroid. Unfortunately, they have only limited water supplies to sustain them.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Hitch-Hiker
programmes.d: Alone on a cross-country trip, a woman continually sees the same hitch-hiker everywhere she looks.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Fever
programmes.d: Tight-fisted Franklin Gibbs is not pleased when his wife wins a trip for two to Las Vegas. But things change when he falls under the spell of a slot machine that calls his name.

programmes.t: The Prophecy: Forsaken
programmes.d: Den episke PROPHECY-saga ender med dette elektriske femte og endelige afsnit, THE PROPHECY: FORSAKEN. Da en fortidig bog om profetier forudsiger Antikrists ankomst, igangsætter en gruppe af faldne engle en nådesløs jagt for at finde den.

programmes.t: The Killing of a Sacred Deer
programmes.d: Steven er dygtig hjertekirurg og gift med Anna, der er respekteret øjenlæge. De lever lykkeligt med deres to børn. Steven er ven med den 16-årige Martin, som er forældreløs. Tingene tager en mørk drejning, da Steven introducerer Martin for familien.

programmes.t: Pay the Ghost
programmes.d: Et år efter sin søns forsvinden under et Halloween-optog oplever Mike Cole på uforklarlig vis sønnens åndelige tilstedeværelse. Sammen med sin ekskone begynder Mike at undersøge en række spor i håbet om at finde ud af, hvad der skete med sønnen.

programmes.t: Popeye's Revenge
programmes.d: Tara og seks venner vil lave Popeye-huset om til et spøgelseshus. Efter en weekend på camping indser de, at legenden er sand. Når tågen kommer, vender Popeye tilbage for at tage Tara og dræbe alle andre.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Rendezvous in a Dark Place
programmes.d: An old woman with an obsession with death attends funerals for entertainment. One night when an injured thief breaks into her home, she lets him die and waits for Death to come and collect him.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Many, Many Monkeys
programmes.d: An epidemic breaks out and many people are struck blind. Something more happens, however: People have become cold and heartless toward each other

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Love Is Blind
programmes.d: A man plotting to murder his wife's lover meets a blind singer who seems to know all about his plans.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Crazy as a Soup Sandwich
programmes.d: A man sells his soul to a demon for some racing tips. After being terrified by the demon he goes for help from the criminal boss he borrowed the track money from

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Special Service
programmes.d: A man finds that his life has been on TV for the past five years

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: The Card
programmes.d: A compulsive spender accepts "The Card" to keep up her habit. Unfortunately stringent penalties kick in for late payments.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Shelter Skelter
programmes.d: A survivalist traps himself in his bomb shelter when a nuclear blast finally comes.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: The Junction
programmes.d: A modern-day miner has an argument with his wife and then goes off to work in the local mine. A collapse traps him, but he finds another survivor - a miner who claims to be from 1912.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Song of the Younger World
programmes.d: In 1916 a girl and a young man from a reformatory for wayward boys fall in love and try to get away from her father, the superintendent. He finds out and doesn't approve of their love, locking away his daughter and punishing the boy.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: The Girl I Married
programmes.d: An attorney and his wife have successful careers. They feel something is lacking in their marriage. Soon, they encounter younger versions of their mates.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: The Curious Case of Edgar Witherspoon
programmes.d: A woman tries to get her Uncle Edgar committed, believing that he is senile. The investigating doctor finds Edgar living in an apartment containing all kinds of junk.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Last Flight
programmes.d: A World War I flying ace flies through a mysterious cloud - and lands at a modern U.S. airbase in the year 1959!

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Purple Testament
programmes.d: Lt. Fitzgerald has found his own special wartime hell. Looking into the faces of his men prior to battle, he has the disquieting ability to see who is about to die.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Elegy
programmes.d: Three astronauts land on what looks like Earth 200 years before they left--only all of the people seem frozen in time.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Mirror Image
programmes.d: Millicent Barnes sees her double at a bus terminal.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Monsters are Due on Maple Street
programmes.d: Paranoia strikes the residents of Maple Street when they believe human-looking aliens have invaded the neighborhood.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: A World of Difference
programmes.d: Businessman Arthur Curtis discovers that life as he knows it doesn't really exist.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Long Live Walter Jameson
programmes.d: Walter Jameson is an excellent history teacher who talks about the past as if he had lived it.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: People Are Alike All Over
programmes.d: When a space exploration crashes on Mars, the surviving passenger is surprised to find that Martians are human-looking, very friendly and apparently just like us...
